cases.sentence: Через пять минут Денисов вошел в балаган, влез с ___ на кровать, сердито выкурил трубку, раскидал все свои вещи, надел нагайку и саблю и стал выходить из землянки.
cases.explain: «грязными ногами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Five minutes later, Denísov came into the hut, climbed with muddy boots on the bed, lit his pipe, furiously scattered his things about, took his leaded whip, buckled on his saber, and went out again. In answer to Rostóv’s inquiry where he was going, he answered vaguely and crossly that he had some business.

cases.explain: «великий государь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Let God and our gweat monarch judge me afterwards!” said Denísov going out, and Rostóv heard the hoofs of several horses splashing through the mud. He did not even trouble to find out where Denísov had gone. Having got warm in his corner, he fell asleep and did not leave the hut till toward evening. Denísov had not yet returned. The weather had cleared up, and near the next hut two officers and a cadet were playing sváyka, laughing as they threw their missiles which buried themselves in the soft mud. Rostóv joined them. In the middle of the game, the officers saw some wagons approaching with fifteen hussars on their skinny horses behind them. The wagons escorted by the hussars drew up to the picket ropes and a crowd of hussars surrounded them.

cases.explain: «соседней землянки» — after the preposition «около», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.

cases.sentence: В середине игры офицеры увидали подъезжавшие к ним повозки: человек 15 гусар на ___ следовали за ними.
cases.explain: «худых лошадях» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.

cases.sentence: — Немного позади гусар ехал Денисов, сопутствуемый двумя ___, с которыми он о чем-то разговаривал.
cases.explain: «пехотными офицерами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “So they are!” said the officers. “Won’t the soldiers be glad!” A little behind the hussars came Denísov, accompanied by two infantry officers with whom he was talking.

cases.explain: «пехотный офицер» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “It is robbery! You’ll answer for it, sir!” said the infantry officer, raising his voice.

cases.sentence: — не робея и не отъезжая, кричал ___, — разбойничать, так я вам...
cases.explain: «маленький офицер» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Very well, then!” shouted the little officer, undaunted and not riding away. “If you are determined to rob, I’ll …”

cases.explain: «скорым шагом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Go to the devil! quick ma’ch, while you’re safe and sound!” and Denísov turned his horse on the officer.

cases.sentence: Повозки, которые подъехали к гусарам, были назначены в ___, но, известившись через Лаврушку, что этот транспорт идет один, Денисов с гусарами силой отбил его.
cases.explain: «пехотный полк» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The wagons that had reached the hussars had been consigned to an infantry regiment, but learning from Lavrúshka that the transport was unescorted, Denísov with his hussars had seized it by force. The soldiers had biscuits dealt out to them freely, and they even shared them with the other squadrons.

cases.sentence: Денисов прямо от ___ поохал в штаб, с искренним желанием исполнить его совет.
cases.explain: «полкового командира» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: From the regimental commander’s, Denísov rode straight to the staff with a sincere desire to act on this advice. In the evening he came back to his dugout in a state such as Rostóv had never yet seen him in. Denísov could not speak and gasped for breath. When Rostóv asked what was the matter, he only uttered some incoherent oaths and threats in a hoarse, feeble voice.

cases.sentence: Когда Ростов спрашивал его, что с ним, он только хриплым и слабым голосом произносил ___ и угрозы.
cases.explain: «непонятные ругательства» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
